test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The capacities of two hemispherical vessel are 2.7 litres and 12.5 litres. Find the ratio of the areas of the inner curved surface of the vessels.
solution:
Given:

Capacity means volume of one hemisphere = 2.7 ltr

Capacity means volume of another hemisphere = 12.5 ltr

**Formula used:**

Volume of hemisphere = 2πr3/3

Curved surface are of hemisphere = 2πr2

Total surface area = 3πr2

1 liter = 1000 cm3

**Calculation:**

 (2)/(3) x (22)/(7) x r₁³ = 2.7 ltr x 1000 cm³ = 2700 

⇒ r₁³ = (675 x 21/11)

⇒ r1 = (675 x 21/11)1/3

Now 

⇒ (2)/(3) x (22)/(7) x r₂3 = 12.5 ltr x 1000 cm3 = 12500

⇒ r₂³ = (3125 x 21/11)

⇒ r2 = (3125 x 21/11)1/3

Required ratio,

⇒ r₁ : r₂ = (675 x 21/11)¹/³ : (3125 x 21/11)¹/³ = 3 : 5

Ratio of the area of the inner curved surface = 2πr₁2/2πr₂2

⇒ r12/r22

⇒ (3/5)² = 9 ∶ 25

**∴ Required ratio is 9 : 25.**
